name: Rubeus Honeysuckle
original_name: ルベウス・ハニーサックル
source:
Vice-Captain of the Police Corps, and [url=/c156185]Sapphirus[/url]'s twin sister. She seems easier to communicate with than her brother, but she's as strait-laced as anyone in military uniform.
Apparently the Imperial Times even wrote "When the Honeysuckle siblings pass by, everyone hangs their head and sighs."

[From Digital Artwork book]
